subscription_products.product_name: Royal Canin Size Health Nutrition Small Puppy Dry Dog Food, 14-lb bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Daily nutrition is non-negotiable. Thor is a 4-month old, 10 lb, high-activity small-breed puppy. Typical small-breed puppy feeding ~1.25 cups/day (~0.3125 lb/day assuming 1 cup ≈ 0.25 lb) → ~9.4 lb/month. A 14-lb bag provides ~14 / 9.4 = 1.5 months of food. Auto-ship every ~6 weeks keeps food fresh and avoids running out during growth.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor is growing fast and burning lots of puppy energy — this small-breed puppy formula will meet his calorie and kibble-size needs. A 14-lb bag will last about six weeks at Thor’s feeding pace; you can always switch sizes if you prefer fewer shipments.

subscription_products.product_name: Pet Botanics Training Rewards Soft & Chewy Puppy Peanut Butter Dog Treats, Mini, 4-oz bag
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: Training treats are used multiple times daily in this socialization window. Estimate: 4-oz bag ≈ 113 g. If an average mini treat ≈ 1.5 g → ~75 treats per bag. For an active training plan (≈8 treats/day during sessions and puppy practice) → 75 / 8 ≈ 9–10 days per bag. Autoship every 2 weeks avoids mid-training shortages without overstocking.
subscription_products.personalized_note: Thor is in the prime learning window — these soft, tiny treats are gentle on his baby teeth and perfect for rewarding the quick wins during leash and potty training.

subscription_products.personalized_note: Starting dental care now will save Thor from dental issues later — this puppy-friendly flavor and starter brush pack make daily tooth time an easy, pleasant habit.

subscription_products.product_name: TropiClean Fresh Breath Oral Care Clean Teeth Plaque & Tartar Defense Puppy Dental Gel, 2-fl oz bottle
subscription_products.subscription_rationale: An enzymatic dental gel complements brushing and is used in small amounts. At ~2 fl oz (~60 ml), using a pea-sized application ~1 ml per brushing at ~5x/week → ~20 ml/month → tube lasts ~3 months. Autoship quarterly keeps dental supplies on schedule.
subscription_products.personalized_note: This enzymatic gel helps reduce plaque between brushings — a great backup for Thor while you’re building a daily brushing habit.

subscription_products.product_name: Pet Botanics Mini Training Reward Bacon Flavor Dog Treats, 10-oz bag

subscription_products.personalized_note: When Thor’s training days get intense, this bigger bag saves you from buying tiny packs constantly — same soft texture that’s gentle on his puppy teeth.

overall_strategy: Thor is a 4‑month-old, 10 lb, high‑activity Pug in apartment life (no yard) and a strong chewer. At this early journey stage we balance two priorities: (1) build an essential, reliable consumables pipeline (food, training treats, poop bags, dental supplies, wet-food toppers) on autoship so the owner never runs out during critical training/socialization, and (2) purchase a small set of durable setup/seasonal items one time now (cooling mat, harness, water bottle, slow feeder, grooming tools, enrichment toys) to keep Thor safe and mentally stimulated. I prioritized small‑breed puppy kibble in a 14‑lb bag (matches Thor’s monthly needs) and frequent treat/waste‑bag resupply cadence based on his walk and training schedule. For toys and chews — because Thor is a strong chewer — I included a few autoship-eligible, heavy‑duty chew replacements to prevent unsafe chewing as a practical (but conservative) subscription option; all other durable enrichment and safety gear are one-time buys. This keeps recurring shipments focused on true consumables and predictable depletion, while one-time purchases cover urgent seasonal safety (cooling) and setup essentials for apartment living.
